CustomField.description: This field will indicate the date of submission for an opportunity. This field is only evaluating for MCA Oppty and Lease Oppty.
CustomField.formula: IF( Opportunity__r.RecordTypeId ="01280000000BZwl", DATEVALUE( Opportunity__r.Statements_In_Date__c ), DATEVALUE( Opportunity__r.Credit_Submittal_Date__c ))
